changed: Device Sync now converges steady-state edits through one guarded pass, queues at most one follow-up, stops before publication until local attach state exists, reuses unchanged peer manifests and verified blobs, settles pending work on shutdown, and pauses for confirmation instead of silently recreating a missing collection.

Add existence-first, baseline-aware classification-safe merge and transactional inbound-apply primitives for Device Sync, including tombstone-safe relation validation and per-owner dependent-row collision guards.
